beats.caption: Multi-cloud GPU training clusters, run by a small on-call team.
beats.zh: 多云的 GPU 训练集群，靠一支小规模值班团队撑着。

beats.caption: The costly mistakes are direction errors. A software bug gets treated as failing hardware.
beats.zh: 贵的误判是方向错：软件的问题，当成硬件坏了。

beats.caption: On-call mode. Nobody pastes a log here; the cluster state is read live from Cloud Firestore.
beats.zh: 值班模式。这里没有人贴日志，集群状态从 Cloud Firestore 实时读出来。

beats.caption: One click starts the shift. In production a scheduler triggers it; a static site has no resident process.
beats.zh: 点一下开始值班。真实部署里由调度器定时触发；纯静态站点没有常驻进程。

beats.caption: It scans the cluster itself, then inspects each node. This shift took 17 tool calls, all on screen.
beats.zh: 它自己扫集群、逐个节点取证。这次值班用了 17 次工具调用，全部在屏幕上。

beats.caption: scan_cluster and inspect_node supply every number the model may use. It does no arithmetic of its own.
beats.zh: 模型能用的每个数字都由 scan_cluster 与 inspect_node 提供；它自己不做算术。

beats.caption: Two nodes, the same fault code: Xid 94.
beats.zh: 两个节点，报的是同一个故障码：Xid 94。

beats.caption: lyg2103: one occurrence in 30 days, correctable ECC flat. Verdict hardware_watch, so no RMA.
beats.zh: lyg2103：30 天只出现 1 次，可纠正 ECC 平稳。判定 hardware_watch，不报修。

beats.caption: lyg2112: 53 occurrences in 30 days, correctable ECC at 118 and still rising. File the RMA.
beats.zh: lyg2112：30 天累计 53 次，可纠正 ECC 已到 118 且仍在上升。建议报修。

beats.caption: The decision came from the trend, not from the code.
beats.zh: 判断依据是趋势，不是那个码本身。

beats.caption: It acted. It cordoned two nodes, and both writes are in the operation log.
beats.zh: 它动手了：cordon 了两个节点，两条写入都在操作日志里。

beats.caption: After each write the app re-reads the value from the server. That is what "verification passed" means here.
beats.zh: 每次写完之后，它会重新读服务端的值。这就是「回验通过」的含义。

beats.caption: The same value, read straight from the Firestore REST API instead of our own interface.
beats.zh: 同一个值，直接取自 Firestore REST API，而不是我们自己的界面。

beats.caption: After a full page reload the state is the same. lyg2112 is still cordoned.
beats.zh: 整页重载之后状态一致，lyg2112 仍然是 cordoned。

beats.caption: The RMA is filled in and ready, with the evidence and commands attached. It is left unsubmitted.
beats.zh: 报修单已经填好，证据与命令都附上了，但故意不提交。

beats.caption: The on-call engineer is notified, with what happened and what is still waiting on them.
beats.zh: 值班人会收到通知：发生了什么，以及还差他哪一步。

beats.caption: The same 14 cases, run two ways. The table lookup scores 11 out of 14.
beats.zh: 同一个案例库的 14 道题，跑两条路径。查 Xid 码表那条对了 11 道。

beats.caption: All three misses need a cause rather than a code: the 30-day trend, and a secondary event read as the root cause.
beats.zh: 错的三题都要看原因而不是码：30 天趋势，以及把次生事件当成了根因。

beats.caption: You can rerun this in the browser. Same code path as the scoring script.
beats.zh: 这个数字你可以在浏览器里自己重跑，和评分脚本共用同一份代码。

beats.caption: Training Failure Triage turns a failure scene into an evidence-backed call, and this one was acted on.
beats.zh: 训练故障分诊器把一次训练失败的现场变成有证据支撑的判断，而这一次已经被真的处置过。
